name: restore-store
description: Static storefront + dashboard template (Supabase backend), brand-neutral, one isolated copy per merchant

scripts.lint: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && node scripts/check-brand.mjs && node scripts/check-assets.mjs && node scripts/check-inline-styles.mjs && node scripts/check-webp.mjs && echo 'lint ok'
scripts.test:db: node tests/db/allinone.integration.mjs && node tests/db/migrations.integration.mjs && node tests/db/fresh-store.integration.mjs
scripts.lint:js: eslint assets/js sw.js scripts tests e2e && node scripts/check-complexity.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:js && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:db
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:e2e && bash scripts/check-secrets.sh
